summary: Named plate-mcp tool profiles with a lean default listing and opt-in profiles via env or CLI flag.
migration_impact: MCP hosts now receive a smaller default tools/list unless PLATE_MCP_TOOL_PROFILES or --tool-profiles includes additional profiles or all. gh plate and CLI behavior are unchanged.
migration_guidance: 1. To restore the full tool catalog in MCP clients, set PLATE_MCP_TOOL_PROFILES=all or pass --tool-profiles=all to plate-mcp.
2. For specialized agents, enable only the profiles you need (see docs/mcp.md).
3. Task specs may reference profile names in tool allow-lists as they land under Epic #1327.
agent_notes: Default MCP attachment uses the default profile alias (~20 tools). Use profile all for exhaustive tool-list tests or full-surface sessions.
